system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Now generate Z3 expressions for the following Python execution path, type list and variable environment:
system_prompt_style.note: Prompt templates with {path}, {types}, {prev_code} variables per module. Repo evidence is walkccc/LeetCode (dataset source), not LLM-Sym code.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: All keys and queries are encoded to vectors using the Sentence-BERT [21] model, and we use the L2-norm as the distance metric for retrieval.
env_context_strategy.note: Also injects extracted CFG execution path and predicted types; retrieval is over a Z3 template KB.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: we split it into chunks before providing it to the Z3 code generator
context_compaction.note: Closest value: each step receives previous code plus SSA variable environment rather than a full chat history; chunking by line is the default.

observation_format.evidence_quote: We input the buggy code and the error message into an LLM, and ask it to fix the code.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: we leverage an LLM to generate code for calling the Z3 solver to solve path constraints.
tool_call_format.note: Implemented with AutoGen; model writes Z3Py code that is executed.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: When the Z3Py code for a chunk is generated, we first concatenate it with the previously generated code and then execute it.
edit_primitive.note: No file-editing tool; harness concatenates generated code.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: we design a multiple-step code generation pipeline including type inference, retrieval and self-refine.
loop_primitives.note: Execution-error-driven self-repair up to 3 times per chunk; LLM solver fallback.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Given a program under test, LLM-Sym first performs type inference to predict the type of variables inside the program.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: then a test case generator LLM takes the solver’s results as input and interprets it as a complete test case.
multi_agent_topology.note: Type predictor -> Z3 code generator -> test case generator, with LLM solver fallback.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: If the Z3 code generation is unsuccessful, we directly use LLM to solve the path constraints and produce test cases.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: we introduce a variable environment to store the SSA indices for each variable.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: In total, we design 14 Python-to-Z3 templates in the knowledge base for retrieving relevant information.
long_term_memory.note: Static hand-built template KB, not updated across runs; closest value.

self_verification.evidence_quote: After generating code for a path chunk, we execute the generated code to check whether it contains bugs.
self_verification.note: Harness executes generated Z3 code and feeds error back; closest value (execution check, not tests).

retry_policy.evidence_quote: In our experiments, we keep tying this self-repair process 3 times for each chunk.
retry_policy.note: Per-chunk repair attempts; fallback to LLM solver.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: If all fixing attempts fail, we terminate the Z3 code generation and directly ask an LLM (the LLM solver in Figure 2) to solve the execution path constraints.
termination_condition.note: LLM solver may print UNSAT and terminate; repair cap of 3.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: apart from the test case generator module, all other modules are powered by the cost-efficient LLM GPT-4o-mini. The test case generator is built upon GPT-4o.
cost_controls.note: Static per-module model assignment chosen for cost.

eval_hooks.note: Paper evaluates on a LeetCode dataset but no harness repo is available.

target_domain.evidence_quote: We create a dataset from LeetCode programs execution paths and evaluate LLM-Sym using this dataset.
target_domain.note: Symbolic execution / test generation; closest value swe.

open_source.note: Linked repo walkccc/LeetCode is the dataset source (MIT), not LLM-Sym code.

model_agnostic.note: Uses OpenAI GPT-4o/4o-mini via AutoGen; abstraction not described.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: We implement the LLM-Sym agent using the AutoGen [33] library.
primary_artifact.note: No LLM-Sym code in evidence; linked repo is unrelated dataset repo.

pinned_version.note: No harness repo; repo evidence walkccc/LeetCode@9b85aa15e086 is the dataset source.
